description: This file defines an intrusive doubly-linked list template class 'SpdyIntrusiveList' and its associated link class 'SpdyIntrusiveLink' within the 'spdy' namespace. It provides list operations such as insertion, deletion, iteration, and splicing, optimized for embedded link pointers in list elements, primarily used for performance-critical or memory-constrained scenarios.

classes.name: SpdyIntrusiveLink
classes.description: A base class for elements to be stored in an intrusive list, containing embedded next and previous pointers, and methods for casting to derived types.

classes.name: SpdyIntrusiveList
classes.description: A template class implementing a doubly-linked intrusive list with operations for insertion, removal, iteration, and splicing, designed for embedded link pointers within list elements.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Insert an element at the end of the list.

methods.name: push_front
methods.description: Insert an element at the beginning of the list.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Remove an element from the list given a pointer to the element.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Return an iterator to the first element.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Return an iterator to the position past the last element.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Return the number of elements in the list (O(N) operation).

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Reset the list to an empty state.
